findings.text: The Page generator regressed: a third column entry reads "[object Map]" and the Journal pane never leaves its loading skeleton, at all four widths (requirement 2, "keep every existing page working"). Evidence: shots/…-core-Page-generator/400.png, the left column under "Atlas"; layout.json widest_text_sample "[object Map]" at 400. The likely cause is the `children` shim: `grow()` assigns `this.children = new Map()`, and some path still reads or renders that value as a child entry.

When a page.jsonl page is reloaded, its own `content` changes are dropped (requirement 3, "each live change appends ONE line to the nearest page.jsonl"). Store.js `line_for` writes `{"at":"content","add":…}`. On replay, `Item.locate("content")` needs `page.content` to already be a LiveList, but `Page.jsonl()` sets `page.content ??= page.log_view`, and `ensure_content()` only runs for a `{"content":…}` key, never for `at:"content"`. Locate warns and the line is ignored. The demo avoids this because it attaches its Store to the LiveList itself, in a separate demo.jsonl.

The demo saves to its own `demo.jsonl`, not to the page's page.jsonl that the brief names (requirement 5). That is a reasonable choice, but nothing records it as one, and the path the brief asked for has the gap in finding 2.

Nothing proves the second tab updates through tail (requirement 5). The shots show only the first load. Also, the demo's "last lines" panel skips every replayed line (`file_store.replaying`), so a second tab's panel won't show a line that arrives from the first tab, even though the rows will move.

`PageLog.Reader.attach` no longer resets `this._seen = null` after the first read. The first `changed()` call after load therefore sees every key from the initial lines and redraws the nav one extra time.
At 1920 and 3440 the live demo's rows column is about 180px wide, with 82–85% of the screen empty (layout.json empty 0.818 / 0.85). The list could take more of the `wide` track.
